decisions.title: Retain pinned React/TypeScript/Vite
direction: Loopback development/preview, no backend or credentials; installed/offline packaging remains separate.

decisions.title: Portable domain and application boundaries
direction: Rules belong in domain, use cases in application, writes through the repository boundary; platform APIs remain adapters.

decisions.title: Exact cents and separate currencies
direction: Use bigint cents, lossless persistence codecs and original EUR/USD. Unvalued USD cannot enter EUR totals.

decisions.title: Immutable posted facts and appended corrections
direction: Drafts do not affect totals. Posting adds balanced journal/audit together; reversals append and retain originals. Full command replay remains future work.

decisions.title: Synthetic session-memory boundary
direction: Keep wholly fictional data. Refresh/reset loses changes; fixture markers are not authentication, encryption or durable storage.

decisions.title: Truthful checks and progress
direction: Keep actual execution, manual verification and release distinct. Tests never auto-promote checkpoints. Browser/device/legal gaps stay visible.

decisions.title: Separate business, legal entity and reporting scope
direction: Business owns financial/evidence records; a label does not prove a separate taxpayer.
Model legal entity, effective reporting-scope membership, activity, project and personal income separately. Relationships carry explicit business scope and reject cross-business references.
Allow unknown setup facts. Preserve existing IDs and exact totals through synthetic schema migration; no new business-specific code branch.

decisions.title: Explicit asynchronous transactional command contract
direction: Before persistent adapters, define async results, failure/recovery semantics and one atomic commit boundary.
Scope command identity by workspace/business. Same ID and canonical payload returns stored result; changed payload fails.
Check ownership and revision inside the transaction. Commit financial state, journal, audit and command receipt atomically; publish/acknowledge only after success.
Use lossless cents codecs with explicit storage range validation; never pass money through floating point.

decisions.title: Immutable originals and recoverable file linking
direction: Retain original bytes, digest, business ownership and provenance; derived previews are distinct.
Stage files with recoverable metadata and defined orphan handling; a database transaction cannot silently make filesystem changes atomic.
Failed operations retain a recoverable state. Prove consistent backup and separate-location restore before genuine financial use; no silent original deletion.

decisions.title: Canonical identifiers and versioned financial context
direction: Separate canonical IDs from English/German labels. Financial dates differ from audit timestamps.
Version profiles, rules, FX valuations and report snapshots; retain the versions used for posted outputs.
Unknown required facts and unvalued currencies block complete official output; the selected E1a/2026 target remains disabled/unverified.

decisions.title: Conditional platform candidates
direction: Tauri/SQLite, native file/camera/notification adapters, cryptography and future hosted providers need their own reviewed decisions and evidence.
P0.C05 is blocked: no accepted native build/device list. Readback is not fsync, encryption, a financial transaction or recovery proof.
Notification requests are not delivery; desktop scheduling is unsupported by the probe plugin. Raw transfer is not authenticated pairing or accounting import.

decisions.title: Bounded packets and explicit acceptance gates
direction: Use existing roadmap IDs, one new checkpoint per continuation. Keep implementation, execution, review and release distinct.
Owner-authorized bounded continuation may defer an earlier review without verifying it. Phase entry still needs acceptance or a recorded scope exception.
Re-estimate each packet after evidence. No P1 implementation, production adapter or real-data activation is authorized by this replacement archive.
